mostWorthwhile.text: Turning the remembered animal painting into an imagined beast was most worthwhile: rearranging familiar features made imagination tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing the pigment was necessary but straightforward, with little to consider on its own.

surprise.text: The cave's echo became a song through memory and a chosen rhythm, connecting a physical effect to creative expression.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely purposeless, though echo plus memory producing a complete song compressed several creative steps.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: the connections between physical processes, imagination and shared learning were engaging, though the fast menu made compatibility choices less exploratory.
